payout_quote: Official outschool.com/teach: 'It's free to list classes on Outschool. We take a 30% service fee from enrollments, so we only get paid when we succeed in bringing you customers. You have full control over the listed price for a class and number of participants. You receive payment via PayPal after the class begins.'
steps: Sign up as an Outschool teacher (free listings).
Create classes, set your price and max participants; pass Outschool's class approval.
Pass the background check (US/Canada) and meet country eligibility.
Teach classes; receive payment via PayPal after the class begins.
catches: Outschool takes a 30% service fee from enrollments — you keep 70% of what you charge.
You set class prices, so earnings are variable; no official pay rate exists.
Background check required (US/Canada); only residents of eligible countries can teach.
Classes must be approved; demand is competitive and enrollment is not guaranteed.
biggest_catch: Outschool takes 30% of every enrollment and you must pass a background check plus country-eligibility rules — you keep 70% of a price you set, but only if learners enroll.
eligibility: Resident of an eligible country; background check (US/Canada); expertise in class topic.
timing: Payment via PayPal after the class begins.
